flow cytometry assay.readouts: frequency of innate immune cell subsets (dendritic cells, monocytes, NK cells) and mean fluorescence intensity of activation/costimulatory surface markers; acquired on a flow cytometer

evidence.quote: PBMC samples were frozen in liquid nitrogen, thawed, stained, and acquired on an LSR Fortessa flow cytometer.

cytometric bead array assay.readouts: plasma concentrations of 13 cytokines/chemokines (including IP-10, MCP-1, MIP-1β); read on a Luminex-200 instrument

evidence.quote: Samples were read in duplicates according to the manufacturer’s protocol on a Bio-Plex Luminex-200 (Bio-Rad) and analyzed using Bio-Plex Manager software.

aliases: Next-Generation RNA Sequencing of Full Blood
RNA Extraction and Next-Generation RNA Sequencing
bulk RNA-seq assay.readouts: gene-level read counts / gene expression levels; sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq 2500

evidence.section: RNA Extraction and Next-Generation RNA Sequencing
evidence.quote: Diluted libraries were multiplex-sequenced on the Illumina HiSeq 2500 instrument (single read, 50-bp run).

enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay.readouts: EBOV glycoprotein-binding antibody levels (optical density; ELISA units/mL) against Kikwit GP or inactivated Gueckedou whole virions

evidence.section: EBOV-GP-Binding Antibody Responses Induced by the Vaccine
evidence.quote: GP-specific antibody responses were measured using an ELISA in two centralized laboratories (Marburg, Germany and United States Army Medical Research Institute for Infectious Diseases [USAMRIID], USA) on days 0, 7, 14, 28, 56, 84, and 180.
